data.title: 阿蕾克希亚 · 深夜露台的独处微澜
data.description: 寂静的王女寝宫露台上寒风微拂。阿蕾克希亚赤足倚着大理石围栏，手抚上曾被硬币弹中的额头，凝视着沉睡的王都夜景，卸去剑士的骄傲与王女的防备，眼眸中流淌着难得的迷茫与柔和。
data.location: palace balcony with ornate white marble balustrade overlooking silent moonlit city roofs
data.action: leaning against the marble railing barefoot, one hand lightly touching her forehead, looking pensively up at the moonlit clouds
data.lighting: cool silver moonlight tracing silhouette and casting soft deep shadows
data.mood: pensive royal solitude, quiet longing, unguarded self-reflection
data.promptProse: Alexia barefoot in a silk slip dress leans on a palace balcony railing at night, pensively gazing into the moonlit capital.
data.animaCaption: Alexia leans against the balcony railing, her face softly lit by moonlight.
